title: Chinta Mani Library v2.3.0 Update (Build 25)
releaseNotes: Dashboard Cards: Numbers styled in deep rich chromatic tones matching each card
Members Directory: Vibrant multicolour student cards (blue, purple, sea green, dark yellow, dark green, pinkish red)
Action Buttons: Red color removed — ID-Card, Edit, Logs, Print, Freeze, Renew now in distinct multicolour palette
Members Filter Cards: Multicolour category selection for Live, Expired, Expiring & All
WhatsApp Section: Students Due Today card made sleek, compact and decent with quick 1-tap Send
Multicolour Theme: Unified across Members, WhatsApp, Seats, and Lockers (no gold outside dashboard)
Navigation Streamlined: Deduplicated content between More section and Left Nav Bar
